XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine failure to start, message relating to fuel blockage (FPS) on the display

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: All vehicles

  • System: Injection

  • Device: Inertia switch

  • Fault: Engine failure to start, message relating to fuel blockage (FPS) in the multifunction display

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: U0427

  • Cause: Activation of the inertia switch

• Action: Proceed with deactivating the inertia switch

  • Procedure: - -

    1- Turn on the ignition
    2- Move the turn signal lever to turn on the right turn signal
    3- Move the turn signal lever to turn off the right turn signal
    4- Move the stalk switch to turn on the left turn signal
    5- Move the stalk switch to turn off the left turn signal
    6- Move the stalk to turn on the right turn signal
    7- Move the stalk to turn off the right turn signal
    8- Move the stalk to turn on the left turn signal
    9- Move the stalk to turn off the left turn signal
    10- Turn off the ignition

    The FPS system is now deactivated, and you can start the engine

  • Note: - -
